title: The user exports
text: The agent never runs an export or queues Media Encoder unless asked. For HKS the user asked for `python -m cutdeck.honekasae_export` to queue and start the export (guess: the rule is "no export unless the user asks"); on 2026-11-24 and 2026-11-25 the agent exported only when asked, and only what had changed.
confirm: Did the user ask for an export, and was only what changed exported?
